test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper wanted to sell ₹3,000 worth of product. He gave two options - giving three successive discounts of 10% each, or giving a single discount of 30%. If a buyer chooses the former option how much extra/less does he pay as compared to the second option?
solution:
**Given:**

 A Rs. 3,000 worth of products can be sold either by giving three successive discounts of 10% each, or by giving a single discount of 30%.

**Formula used:**

Final price = frac{100- {discount}}{100}times {marked price}</p
